description: Get a Stripe checkout link for AgentDomains Pro: names kept after the 30-day free trial for as long as you pay, 100 names instead of 10, visitor stats, names never removed for being unused, and priority support, for $10/year (interval 'year', the better deal) or $1/month. Use this when the trial is ending and the user wants to keep their names, or when a claim is refused because the account is at its name limit and the user wants more. It only returns a link and never charges anything: a human must open the URL and pay. Show them the url and say what Pro costs; do not open it or pay on their behalf. If the account is already Pro the answer has kind:'portal' and a link to manage the subscription instead. Answers 404 'billing is not enabled' on a server that does not sell Pro.

api_key.description: Your AgentDomains API key (adom_…). Only needed when this MCP connection has no `Authorization: Bearer` header, for example right after calling signup.

interval.description: Billing interval: 'month' ($1, the default) or 'year' ($10, the better deal).

name: upgrade_to_pro
title: Get a Pro checkout link
